item.title: Halloween Costume Swap Drop Off
item.description:
Clean out your closets and take home a new costume!

Bring in your clean, gently used Halloween costumes and accessories — hats, masks, onesies, wings, horns, capes, and more! Donations of all sizes and for all ages are accepted, beginning on Saturday, October 17. 

You do not have to donate to browse and take home costume items on Friday, October 23, and Saturday, October 24!

item.title: Tai Chi & Qigong
item.description:
Join us on Saturday mornings for Tai chi and Qigong led by volunteer instructor, Thầy Đàm Hạnh. 

Tai chi is a traditional Chinese martial art involving a series of slow, gentle movements and physical postures, meditation, and controlled breathing. Tai chi is low impact, placing minimal stress on muscles and joints, making it generally safe for all ages and fitness levels. 

Also rooted in traditional Chinese martial arts and medicine, Qigong involves using movement and breathing exercises to optimize energy within the body, mind, and spirit, with the goal of improving and maintaining health and well-being.

All are welcome!

Registration is not required to attend, but make sure to sign up below to receive email reminders and cancellation notices.

item.title: Citizenship Preparation Class
item.description:
Your Path to Citizenship Starts Here!

In partnership with St. Mark Communication Education, join us for a comprehensive 11-week course designed to prepare you for your Naturalization interview.

The Citizenship exam preparation class includes instruction to improve English and to learn all 128 questions of the civics portion of the test. Taught by experienced and trained teachers. Individual tutoring is available in each class to review lesson materials.

Eligibility requirements:

  1. Applied for citizenship on or after October 20, 2025
  2. Have your green card for 4 years and 9 months or 2 years and 9 months if your spouse is a US Citizen.
  3. Be able to speak some English.

Please visit this link to register.
